description: Répartition des potentiels de gaz verts à horizon 2050 par département is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente la répartition par département du potentiel en gaz verts par type de ressource et par filière en France à l'horizon 2050. Les hypothèses et le contexte de l'étude sont présentées dans l'étude " Un mix de gaz 100% renouvelable en 2050 ? Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Production, Territoires et régions, Environnement. Its keywords are EnR, Prospective, Biogaz, Pyrogazeification. The portal shows 2018-10-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
